top_band: white/light blue-grey snow-covered pitched roof slope from row 8 to row 36
evidence: The building clearly shows a large sloped roof surface seen from above (rows 8-36, 29px tall) overhanging a vertical log wall south face below (rows 37-62, 26px tall). Under the roof eave (row 36) there is a distinct dark eave shadow (rows 37-38) with icicles hanging down, and the door and windows are recessed with snow-topped sills and lintels.

style.evidence: The cabin matches the Beodeul reference standard well: the snow roof has layered horizontal ridge and clump textures using 4-5 blue-white tones, the log walls have distinct cylindrical shading and wood grain steps (5 browns), windows have glowing multi-step panes and shutters, and outlines use dark brown and dark blue-grey material tones rather than flat black.
